design: 16 held-out continuous parameter combinations x 4 masks x 2 fan regimes x 2 horizons x 2 noise profiles x 3 cost profiles; no outcome-based selection
metric: Observed current CH4 interval width reduction in percentage points / abstract restoration cost
counterfactual: Every restoration starts from a deep copy of exactly the same state and RNG streams; other channels are not resampled
repair_assumption: Restored channel obtains a fresh unbiased noiseless simulator reading; observer retains its stated tolerance

coverage.scope: empirical check inside declared bounds and bounded errors, not a statistical confidence level

limitations: No field calibration or physical probabilities
Related cases are not independent field observations
Current methane width objective assigns zero immediate value to flow-only restoration
No crew logistics or real economic cost
Out-of-bound faults can escape detection without measurements
